coaching.headline: Allies took every Fangtooth, the Mini Prime and Genesis Core, and Murdock died thirteen times, ten on the duo lane.

flags.text: Crunch was a fucking wrecking ball: game-high 39708 hero damage, razed offlane outer, inner, inhibitor, mid inhibitor.
Kallari led all ten in objective damage with 27271, while the enemy team dealt zero.
After the third Fangtooth, the next fight went one for three: Kallari, Narbash and Crunch died.

focus.title: Cash late Fangtooths with a structure
focus.action: After a late Fangtooth, Kallari, Narbash and Crunch join Skylar on the nearest exposed inhibitor first, and take no mid fight into Gideon and Murdock until that inhibitor falls.

22.4.call: Skylar killed Murdock on the duo lane and Kallari killed Gideon on mid as Crunch razed the enemy offlane inner; the second Fangtooth followed. Repeat that order.

24.7.call: Gideon killed Narbash and Aurora killed Skylar on the duo lane, then the enemy mid inner fell and Countess killed Murdock on mid: two separate plays.

29.2.call: Fangtooth and Genesis Core went allied before the lost exchange, Kallari and Crunch falling on mid, and Skylar razed the duo inhibitor seconds after the last allied death.

8f50ef0b-39f0-4fac-845f-b7de168ce90c: Killed Mourn all three times Mourn died, at 1203 hero damage per minute against a 618 norm. Whenever Mourn is dead, push the offlane structure first.
Died to Kaelen on the offlane outside any detected fight right after the second Fangtooth, and the allied offlane outer fell next. With Kaelen unseen, ward before pushing.
025ec768-9507-48e4-8f99-161f7a544a18: Six of eight kills landed on Murdock, every one on the duo lane. While Murdock keeps dying there, path through the duo lane before each Fangtooth.
Died to Aurora on the duo lane outside any detected fight, and to Gideon on mid after the third Fangtooth. Next late major, avoid mid until Gideon shows.
33c3987a-ca3e-4e11-900a-daac53bb60b2: All three deaths went to Gideon. Dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift, walk out of Black Hole early, and dive Gideon only after Torn Space is used.
CS hit 11.7 per minute on a 7.8 norm, but hero damage only 546 per minute on a 777 norm. Once the enemy mid outer falls, join duo-lane fights.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Ran the vision and the sustain: 19 wards against an 8.9 norm and 24099 healing, both game highs. Before every Fangtooth, keep that ward pace.
Zero wards destroyed while Aurora placed eight, and kill participation sat at 38%. If a sentry is equipped, clear the Fangtooth approach before each take.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Razed the duo outer, duo inhibitor and Core: 8348 objective damage. Keep finishing structures right after a won fight, as at the Core.
Two of four deaths came from Aurora on the duo lane and one from Mourn outside any detected fight. While Aurora's Hoarfrost is up, stay behind Narbash.

matchup: Offlane was Crunch against Mourn: Crunch went 8/3/3 to Mourn's 1/3/6 and out-damaged Mourn 39708 to 31866.
Kaelen, not Mourn, took two of three Crunch deaths, both on the offlane.
build: Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing on physical damage, an answer to Mourn and Aurora, the two enemy healers.
Sky Splitter's basic attacks deal a share of the target's current health, reduced against ranged heroes.
Absolution came after Crunch's second death to Kaelen; on being immobilized, Absolution grants damage mitigation and movement speed.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage to that hero, less damage taken from that hero.
Nihil and Vesh lead a toss-up in the Crunch offlane field; Thraex, the most played, ranks near the bottom.
Alpha's Court with Ferocity is the most played Thraex pair; Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best pair.
augment: Combo Crunch grants stacking attack speed when Cross Crunch deals damage.
Lunge Crunch leans ahead of Combo Crunch, the most played, in the Crunch offlane field.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Brutallax, Iceskorn Talons and Gravitum lead a toss-up in the Crunch offlane field; Judgement, the most played, ranks behind all three.
improvement: Mistmeadow Buckler, 16% of builds into Mourn, wins 55.4% and adds magical armor; Crunch took 17016 magical damage, 10478 physical.
Tenacity need met through Absolution, against an enemy kit with 11 hard-CC abilities to 5.
Lunge Crunch over Combo Crunch is the field lean: a longer Forward Crunch instead of Cross Crunch attack speed stacks.

matchup: Jungle was Kallari against Kaelen: one kill each, a second apart on the duo lane.
Kaelen's Frostfall and Winter's Pursuit both root; fight after both are spent.
build: Malady and Vanquisher match the most-played core into Kaelen; Spear Of Desolation, the third piece, was skipped.
Solaris empowers the next basic attack after each ability cast and heals for part of that damage.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
eternal: Lotus grants a random bonus every two minutes and on each takedown.
Lotus leans first in the Kallari jungle field. Sound keep.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna is the most played Lotus pair; Masterpiece with Immaculate is the best pair.
augment: Critical Override lets abilities critically strike, at reduced critical damage.
Deadly Finesse leans first in the Kallari jungle field; Critical Override ranks last of three.
crest: Nex's active dashes and deals damage boosted by stored Sow damage, with a brief slow.
Ortus is clearly the best Kallari jungle crest; Nex, the most played, ranks last.
improvement: Spear Of Desolation completes the most-played core into Kaelen, 57.1% over 28 games, in place of Solaris.
Ortus, the field's clear best, over Nex: an active speed and power burst; takedowns inside the burst add permanent power.
Deadly Finesse leans over Critical Override: Crippling Dagger hits cut the dagger cooldown and restore mana, giving up ability crits.

matchup: Mid was Countess against Gideon: Gideon won the kill exchange three to two, opening with first blood.
Countess took 18784 magical damage from heroes out of 23143 total.
build: Combustion and Noxia match the most-played core into Gideon; Wraith Leggings, the third piece, was skipped.
Oblivion Crown raises total magical power; Dreambinder slows on ability damage and adds health.
Megacosm, finished last, burns a share of target max health over time; earlier fights ran without Megacosm.
eternal: Vesh adds a burn over time worth part of each ability hit on heroes; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Aion and Lotus lead a toss-up in the Countess mid field; Vesh, the most played, ranks last.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Millennia is the most played.
augment: Shadow Echo repeats Shadow Slip's damage at the current spot when swapping places with the Shadow.
Shadow Echo leans first in the Countess mid field. Sound keep.
crest: Voidgazer fires a piercing projectile that slows and boosts damage dealt to targets hit.
Voidgazer posts a higher rate on too few games to lead; Tempest and Soulbearer lead a toss-up in the Countess mid field.
improvement: World Breaker, NOT built, answers 11 enemy hard-CC abilities with tenacity, in place of Dreambinder.
Magical armor, NOT built, blunts Gideon's burst; no item in the build carried any.
Wraith Leggings completes the most-played core into Gideon, 59.6% over 47 games.

matchup: Duo was Narbash and Skylar against Aurora and Murdock; before minute ten allied duo deaths were one, enemy two.
Two of three Narbash deaths went to Gideon, both in the allied half.
build: Truesilver Bracelet, Crystal Tear and Everbloom, a core winning 66.1% over 165 games, were all built, Dynamo before Everbloom.
Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take more damage briefly, so a Thunk stun sets up the follow-up.
Crystal Tear grants magical power and ability haste to both Narbash and the healed hero.
eternal: Exarch gives healed or shielded targets attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage.
Exarch leads a toss-up with Krix in the Narbash support field. Sound keep.
Preservation with Fervour trails Preservation with Delayed Fate, the best Exarch pair.
augment: Thonk drops Thunk after an enemy hit; picking Thunk up refunds part of the cooldown and mana.
Thonk leads a toss-up with War Anthem in the Narbash support field. Sound keep.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds up nearby allies and grants immunity to slows.
Sanctification leans first in the Narbash support field; Leafsong ranks behind Tranquility as well.
improvement: No unmet need in the build notes; no item change is proven.
Sanctification over Leafsong is the crest lean: a team shield with tenacity instead of the speed burst.
Delayed Fate over Fervour fits the best Exarch pair: 20% of ability damage taken becomes a 3s DoT.

matchup: Duo was Skylar and Narbash against Murdock and Aurora; Skylar went 5/4 and out-earned Murdock 17227 gold to 14635.
Murdock's Static Trap roots; fight after the traps are spent.
build: Lightning Hawk, Scattershot and Equinox opened the build: an on-hit slow, homing splash projectiles and a low-health shield.
Into Murdock the most-played core is Plasma Blade, Vanquisher and Imperator at 47.7%; only Imperator was built.
Imperator, finished last, raises critical strike damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed; Bone Collector adds critical chance after enough unit kills.
Xyris is clearly the best Skylar carry Eternal, and Iron Will with Bone Collector the best Xyris pair. Sound keep.
augment: Assault MK-II extends Air Assault's hover and adds a missile per attack.
Assault MK-II leans first in the Skylar carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier is clearly the best Skylar carry crest; Liberator, the most played, ranks behind.
improvement: No unmet need in the build notes; no core change is proven.
Equinox stays over Tainted Rounds: Crunch's Tainted Blade already carried anti-heal, and Equinox keeps the low-health shield.
Pacifier over Liberator is the clear crest swap: a dash and empowered hit, strongest on low-health targets, instead of the cleanse.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn, Aurora. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk into Camouflage, Crippling Dagger to slow, Shadow Dance onto the Death Marked target for double damage, then Guillotine to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Catch an isolated low-health target from Camouflage and finish them with Guillotine's missing-health damage.
ourKits.passive: Death Mark reveals targets she damages and detonates for missing-health true damage, and she can jump extra times in the air.
ourKits.playWith: A team that follows up on her picks and fights around vision.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ward and stay near teammates since nearby heroes and wards reveal Camouflage. Guillotine has a brief delay before the dash, so CC her during it or after Shadow Dance; stay healthy since her damage grows on low targets.

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip dashes in, Eventide and Blade Siphon hit to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast suppresses the Haemorrhaged target for bonus damage and full healing, with Shadow Slip recast to swap back out
ourKits.winCondition: Feast a Haemorrhaged squishy for bonus damage, heal it back, and escape through the Shadow swap
ourKits.passive: hitting a hero with two abilities within a short window applies Haemorrhage, a max-health true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her engage, so peel or punish after it is spent; note where her Shadow was left, since she can swap back to it; magic armor and anti-heal blunt her Blade Siphon and Feast healing

ourKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
ourKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
ourKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
ourKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
ourKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Narbash can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 633 healing a minute, more than 98% of Kallari jungle players this patch.
Guillotine at top rank: 85s base, about 72s by the end (15% shorter) from 18 ability haste: Malady 8, Solaris 10.
13 takedowns (8 kills, 5 assists) fed: Malady (Demise).
Kallari dealt 29,285 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +215 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Vanquisher 12; against Murdock (level 17 estimated: about 110 physical armor, 87 after penetration) and Gideon (level 17 estimated: about 103 physical armor, 80 after penetration) that is about 12% and 13% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Malady (item): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Solaris (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Sustain: Solaris: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.; 20,892 healing recorded.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Kallari killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Mourn, Murdock, Gideon. We killed Kallari 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Kallari jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

evidence: 29.2m: Kallari died to Gideon on the mid lane in their half
29.4m: Narbash died to Gideon in our jungle
29.5m: Crunch died to Murdock on the mid lane in their half
8/3/3, 39708 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 1203 vs their Crunch norm 618.

bullets: On a cooldown, Combustion turns a Cosmic Rift or Void Breach hit into an extra 50 (+18%) blast on the target and nearby enemies.
Gideon's magical damage applied Tainted Scepter, cutting the target's healing by 45% for 4s; up to 15 Malice stacks added damage to ability hits on heroes.
At top rank, 45 ability haste cut Black Hole from 105s to about 72.4s; Timewarp also took 1s off the other abilities' cooldowns every 8s.
Cross Crunch empowers the basic attack after each ability and trims 1s off current cooldowns, so the ability-then-attack rhythm reached the Re-Crunch heal on every third hit quickly.
Sky Splitter added 5% of the target's current health to each basic attack hit, while Nuclear Rounds raised ability damage 10-20% based on critical strike chance.
Tainted Blade: physical hits cut the target's healing by 45% for 3s, and ability damage on that target then made the target take 5% more damage for 3s.
After an ability cast, Solaris (short cooldown) empowered the next basic attack within 4s: bonus damage that could critically strike, healing Kallari for 50% of that damage.
Imperator makes critical strikes deal 30% more damage, so a Solaris attack that critically strikes hits harder and heals Kallari for more.
Against a hero below 40% health, Malady added damage, and Guillotine deals up to 2.5x damage based on missing health; takedowns reset the Malady cooldown.
